u0051.line: 'Bharat Taxi', India's first cooperative-based ride-hailing platform → launched at Vigyan Bhavan, New Delhi by Amit Shah, Home and Cooperation Minister (February 2026).

u0052.line: PLASTINDIA 2026 (5–10 February 2026) → inaugurated at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi; theme 'Bharat Next'.

u0053.line: Sunetra Pawar → sworn in as Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra (31 Jan 2026).

u0054.line: UP Statehood Day (24 Jan 2026), Rashtra Prerna Sthal, Lucknow: Amit Shah launched 'One District, One Cuisine', inaugurated Sardar Patel Industrial Area Scheme; UP tableau: 'Culture of Bundelkhand'.
u0054.trap: Launched = One District, One Cuisine; inaugurated = Sardar Patel Industrial Area Scheme. UP tableau = 'Culture of Bundelkhand'; Ministry of Culture tableau = '150 Years of Vande Mataram'.

u0055.line: Union Cabinet approved continuing the Atal Pension Yojana (APY) up to FY 2030–31 (21 January 2026).

u0056.line: Learjet 45 of M/s VSR Ventures crashed at Baramati (28 Jan 2026) on the Mumbai–Baramati sector; five on board, including Maharashtra Deputy CM Ajit Pawar.

u0057.line: UIDAI (Unique Identification Authority of India) launched the new Aadhaar mascot 'Udai' (January 2026).

u0058.line: 20th session of UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage Committee → Red Fort, New Delhi (8–13 Dec 2025), chaired by Vishal V. Sharma; Deepavali inscribed → India now 16 elements.
u0058.trap: 20 = session number; 16 = India's elements after Deepavali.

u0059.line: India's first fully indigenous hydrogen fuel cell-powered passenger vessel → commercial operations began in Varanasi (11 December 2025).

u0060.line: Bihar Police announced a special squad called 'Abhaya Brigade' (December 2025).

u0061.line: Amit Shah, Home and Cooperation Minister, inaugurated a Bio-CNG and Fertilizer Plant in Vav–Tharad district, Gujarat (6 December 2025).

u0062.line: Maharashtra set a Guinness World Record: 45,911 solar irrigation pumps installed in one month (December 2025).

u0063.line: World Summit on Disaster Management (WSDM) 2025 → Dehradun (28–30 November 2025).

u0064.line: India Internet Governance Forum (IIGF) 2025, fifth edition → New Delhi (27–28 Nov 2025). 4th Kashi Tamil Sangamam → Varanasi.
u0064.trap: IIGF 2025 = fifth edition; Kashi Tamil Sangamam = 4th edition.

u0065.line: Sardar@150 Unity March (26 Nov–6 Dec 2025) → nationwide march for Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's 150th birth anniversary.

u0066.line: Sixteenth Finance Commission (Chairman Dr. Arvind Panagariya) submitted its report for 2026–27 to 2030–31 to the President of India (17 Nov 2025).
u0066.trap: Report was submitted in 2025 but covers 2026–27 to 2030–31.

u0067.line: Nitish Kumar took oath as Chief Minister of Bihar for the tenth time (20 November 2025).

u0068.line: India launched its first indigenous CRISPR-based gene therapy → for sickle cell disease (19 November 2025).

u0069.line: International Arya Mahasammelan 2025 → New Delhi (30 Oct–2 Nov 2025); marked Arya Samaj's 150th anniversary and Maharshi Dayanand Saraswati's 200th birth anniversary.
u0069.trap: 150 = Arya Samaj's anniversary; 200 = Dayanand Saraswati's birth anniversary.

u0070.line: Eighth Session of the International Solar Alliance (ISA) Assembly → Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi (27–30 Oct 2025); theme 'One Sun, One World, One Grid'.
u0070.hook: Three 'One's: One Sun, One World, One Grid.

u0071.line: WHO released 'State of Inequality in Non-communicable Diseases and Their Risk Factors' (20 Oct 2026): four diseases (cardiovascular, cancer, diabetes, chronic respiratory) and five risk factors.

u0072.line: IMF World Economic Outlook, October 2026: 'Resilience Under Strain, Urgent Choices'; global growth projected 3.1% for 2026 and 3.4% for 2027.

u0073.line: 2026 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences → Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford, for research on microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation.

u0074.line: 2026 Nobel Peace Prize → Navi Pillay (Navanethem Pillay), a jurist from South Africa, for efforts to promote peace and international law.

u0075.line: UN Climate Change Conference COP–31 → Antalya, Türkiye; scheduled from 9 to 20 November 2026.

u0076.line: 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature → Anne Carson, writer from Canada (announced 8 October 2026).

u0077.line: Young Indian cricketer Vaibhav Suryavanshi → included in TIME magazine's TIME–100 Next, 2026 list (September 2026).

u0078.line: Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2027 (30 Sept 2026): first Oxford, second MIT; India's best → Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru (joint 254th).
u0078.trap: The rankings are named '2027' but were released in September 2026.

u0079.line: Global Innovation Index 2026 by WIPO (World Intellectual Property Organization): Switzerland first; India 38th.

u0080.line: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri → Morocco's first woman head of government, appointed by King Mohammed VI (29 September 2026).

u0081.line: 28th session of FAO Committee on Forestry → Rome, Italy (28 Sept–2 Oct 2026), with tenth World Forest Week; State of the World's Forests 2026 theme: forest and landscape restoration.
u0081.trap: 28th = Committee on Forestry session; tenth = World Forest Week edition.

u0082.line: Global Gender Gap Index 2026 by World Economic Forum (WEF): Iceland first; India 131st.

u0083.line: UNICEF: climate-related disasters disrupted education of more than 17.1 crore students worldwide in 2025 — one in every ten students.

u0084.line: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir (Bangladesh Nationalist Party) → President of Bangladesh (21 Aug 2026); official residence: Bangabhaban.

u0085.line: First direct commercial container freight train India → Nepal (28 July 2026): Kolkata Port → Biratnagar Customs Yard, via Indian border station Jogbani.
u0085.trap: Jogbani is the Indian border station; Biratnagar is the destination in Nepal.

u0086.line: Keiko Fujimori → President of Peru (capital Lima) (28 July 2026). ASEAN 2026 chairmanship theme: 'Navigating Our Future, Together'.

u0087.line: President Droupadi Murmu's July 2026 state visits → Moldova (first stop), North Macedonia (first-ever Indian President's visit) and Romania.
u0087.hook: M-N-R route: Moldova → North Macedonia → Romania.

u0088.line: UN Department of Economic and Social Affairs released the SDG Report 2026 (7 July 2026); 17 Sustainable Development Goals, deadline 2030.

u0089.line: PM Narendra Modi received Indonesia's highest civilian honour 'Bintang Adipurna' from President Prabowo Subianto (7 July 2026).

u0090.line: First Global Dialogue on Artificial Intelligence Governance → Geneva, Switzerland, under the United Nations (6–7 July 2026).

u0091.line: ITU announced the 'AI for Good Global Commission' (2 July 2026); founding leadership includes Rwanda's President Paul Kagame; ITU headquarters: Geneva.

u0092.line: Ireland took the rotating presidency of the Council of the European Union for the eighth time (1 July to 31 December 2026).

u0093.line: 52nd G7 Summit → Évian-les-Bains, France (June 15–17, 2026), led by Emmanuel Macron; PM Modi represented India; Migrant Smuggling Declaration; Japan's PM Takaichi launched POWERR Asia.

u0094.line: 16th BRICS Agriculture Ministers' Meeting → Indore, Madhya Pradesh (June 12–13, 2026) under India's BRICS Presidency; Indore Declaration adopted.

u0095.line: Slovakia's highest national award, 'Order of the White Double Cross' → presented to PM Modi in Bratislava (June 2026).

u0096.line: Uzbekistan → became the 10th member of the New Development Bank (NDB), June 2026.
u0096.check: The question says Uzbekistan joined 'in June 2026' but the story is dated May 21, 2026.

u0097.line: Janez Janša assumed office as Prime Minister of Slovenia (4 June 2026).

u0098.line: Ahmadou Al Aminou Lo assumed office as the new Prime Minister of Senegal (25 May 2026).

u0099.line: 8th India–France Maritime Cooperation Dialogue → Paris, France (22 May 2026).

u0100.line: Saudi Arabia → 26th member country of the India-led 'International Big Cat Alliance' (IBCA) (May 2026).
